title: Welcome
note: The envelope, the name, one line of what the book is. Two buttons: begin, or "I was invited".
text: Early Letters The memory book you fill by talking. A few words a day, in your own voice. Kept for your child to read and hear for years. Begin the book I was invited
lines: The memory book you fill by talking.
